clue.text: Old man developing nice tan

definitions.note: an ancient, as a noun, is an aged person, an old man

indicators.note: developing means changing form, so the letters of nice and tan are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An elderly man is getting a suntan on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, an ancient is an aged person, so the phrase for an elderly fellow names it.

clue.text: Paid close attention — pages after article told a story

indicators.note: after places the pages abbreviation following the article

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
to tell a story, euphemistically, is to lie, so told a story gives LIED

explanation.surface: Someone listened carefully while pages following an article spun a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Told a story' is a polite way of saying told a lie.
explanation.definitionFit: If you applied yourself, you concentrated hard: a synonym for paying close attention.

clue.text: Lesson by one Conservative of the highest rank

parts.note: a lesson is a class at school
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A top-notch lesson taught by a member of the Conservative party.
explanation.definitionFit: Something classic is first-rate, of the best quality, an adjectival synonym.

clue.text: Go in hospital department with expression of hesitation

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital
er is the sound someone makes when hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone walks into a hospital department hesitantly, saying er.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct verb synonym: to go in through a door is to come into a place.

clue.text: Difficult catch with line at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters of catch and line are jumbled

explanation.surface: Landing a fish with a line out on the ocean is a tricky business.
explanation.definitionFit: A technical problem or passage is one requiring specialist skill, hence hard or complicated.

clue.text: Fashion designer embracing new means of communication

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so the designer's name holds the abbreviation for new

parts.note: Coco Chanel was the famous French fashion designer

explanation.surface: A couturier is hugging something novel that lets people communicate.
explanation.definitionFit: A channel is a medium or route through which messages pass, like a TV channel or a channel of communication.

clue.text: Dog taken to vet with no tail to bend

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: with no tail means the last letter of the word vet is cut off

explanation.surface: A dog brought to the vet with its tail docked must bend.
explanation.definitionFit: A curve is a bend in a line or road, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Soldier wearing suitable American equipment

indicators.note: wearing means having on, so the word for suitable goes around the soldier

parts.note: apt means suitable or fitting
a para is a paratrooper, a soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier is dressed in proper American kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparatus is the gear or set of instruments used for a task, a synonym of equipment.

clue.text: No one is turning the Queen more boisterous

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: turning means the little word is is read backwards

parts.note: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Nobody is turning the monarch into someone rowdier.
explanation.definitionFit: Noisier is the comparative of noisy, meaning louder and more rowdy, matching more boisterous.

clue.text: They might put up with you

definitions.text: They might put up with you

parts.words: They might put up with you
parts.note: to put up with someone usually means tolerate them, but here it means stay in the same house as a paying guest

explanation.surface: Some people could tolerate your company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up' reads as tolerate, but means take accommodation: paying boarders put up (stay) in your home alongside you.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying boarders stay, or put up, in a house alongside the householder.

clue.text: Unattractively artificial closing in picture

indicators.note: in places the word for closing inside the short form of picture

parts.note: pic is a short form of picture
closing means final, last

explanation.surface: The ending of a film looks tacky and fake.
explanation.definitionFit: Plastic is used figuratively for something synthetic, false and tasteless, like a plastic smile.

clue.text: Returned embarrassed about movement in ballet

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the colour of embarrassment goes around the ballet move

parts.note: an embarrassed person goes red
a plie is a ballet movement bending the knees

explanation.surface: A flustered dancer came back on stage for a ballet move.
explanation.definitionFit: To return a remark is to answer it, so returned means answered, a past-tense synonym.

clue.text: Security at home certain to restrict an onset in crime

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: to restrict means to hem in, so the word for certain closes around the other letters

parts.note: sure means certain

indicators.note: onset in picks out the opening letter of the following word crime

explanation.surface: Home security is sure to limit the start of a crime wave.
explanation.definitionFit: Insurance provides financial protection against loss, a form of security or safeguard.

clue.text: Heard to waste American's increase in wages

indicators.note: heard means the word that follows is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: to raze is to lay waste, to level a building

explanation.surface: Word goes around that squandering an American's pay increase is bad.
explanation.definitionFit: In US usage, a raise is what Britons call a pay rise, an increase in salary.

clue.text: Avoids birds

definitions.meaning: to dodge something by bending down quickly is a verb sense

explanation.surface: Someone sidesteps the waterfowl.
explanation.definitionFit: One word is both the verb for dodging a blow and the plural of a common waterbird.

clue.text: 12 cast off steps

indicators.note: off means out of order, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: 12 refers to the answer to 12 across, RAISE

explanation.surface: A dozen actors were dismissed from the stage steps.
explanation.walkthrough: The 12 is a cross-reference to the 12-across answer, whose letters join CAST before being jumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps within a building is a staircase, the whole set of stairs.

clue.text: Rears cute wild animals

indicators.note: wild means out of control, so the letters of Rears and cute are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone raises adorable wild beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Creatures is a general word for living beings, especially animals.

clue.text: German city 'ethically' neglected, oddly. It's necessary

parts.note: Essen is a city in the Ruhr, Germany

indicators.note: with the odd letters ignored, only the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of the quoted word remain

explanation.surface: A German city behaves unethically, which is a must.
explanation.definitionFit: Essential means indispensable, absolutely required, a synonym of necessary.

clue.text: Lass with belly changing? Babies — there's two there

definitions.note: the word babies splits into two sound units, ba and bies

indicators.note: changing means altering, so the letters of Lass and belly are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pregnant girl's belly is changing, and twins are on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests twin babies, but the definition counts the parts of the word babies itself: ba-bies.
explanation.definitionFit: Units of pronunciation: the word babies has two of them, so the phrase defines them by example.

clue.text: Becomes bitter, covering up Church origins

indicators.note: covering up means enclosing, so the word for turning bitter goes around the church abbreviation

parts.note: milk sours when it turns bitter
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone grows resentful while hiding the Church's beginnings.
explanation.definitionFit: Sources are where things come from, their starting points or origins.

clue.text: Allowing the French time can start to grate

parts.note: le is French for the
a tin is a can

indicators.note: start to picks the first letter of the word grate

explanation.surface: Letting French time pass can begin to irritate.
explanation.definitionFit: Letting is the present participle of let, meaning permitting or allowing.

clue.text: Abandon brush

definitions.meaning: a stiff brush for cleaning, or low bushy vegetation

explanation.surface: Drop the broom!
explanation.definitionFit: The word is informal for calling something off and also names a hard bristle brush or undergrowth.

clue.text: Concerned with rent? Save!

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to lease is to rent out

explanation.surface: A tenant worried about rent is told to economise.
explanation.definitionFit: To release a captive is to free or rescue them, a sense of save.

clue.text: Hampers ventures, getting round request

indicators.note: getting round means surrounding, so the wagers go around the word for request

parts.note: to venture money is to bet it, so bets are ventures
to ask is to request

explanation.surface: Risky schemes hold things up by evading a request.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hampers' looks like a verb meaning hinders, but it is the noun: wicker picnic hampers.
explanation.definitionFit: Hampers are large wicker containers, a type of large lidded wicker container.

clue.text: Player's first to leave golf club, say

indicators.note: to leave means a letter goes away from the club's name

parts.note: a putter is a golf club used on the green

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word Player's

explanation.surface: A golfer's opening putter leaves the bag, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To utter is to speak or voice words, a verb synonym of say.

clue.text: Philosopher's following snake — they go round and round

indicators.note: following puts the philosopher's name after the word for snake

parts.note: to snake is to wind, as a road does
John Stuart Mill was the English philosopher; Mill's gives MILLS

explanation.surface: A thinker is chasing a serpent around in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: Their sails rotate endlessly in the wind, so they are things that go round and round.

clue.text: Women warm source of food?

parts.note: to warm something is to heat it

explanation.surface: Women warming up a meal from its source.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheat is the cereal grain milled into flour, a basic origin of much food, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Nothing in drizzle can make you damp

indicators.note: in places the letter for nothing inside the word for drizzle

parts.note: mist is fine rain, like drizzle
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Even a little light rain will leave you wet.
explanation.definitionFit: Moist means slightly wet, a direct synonym of damp.

clue.text: Citrus tree almost devoured by cold weather

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the tree's name is dropped

parts.note: a lime is a citrus tree
devoured means ate

explanation.surface: Frost has eaten away most of a lime tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Climate is the prevailing weather conditions of a region over time, loosely the weather.

clue.text: Mirror? One friend holds it

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: holds means contains, so the word for friend goes around it

parts.note: a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: A looking glass is held by a pal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mirror' looks like a noun, but it is the verb: to copy someone's actions.
explanation.definitionFit: To mirror someone is to copy their behaviour exactly, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Intimate guests ordered to go round back of building

indicators.note: to go round means surround, so the rearranged guests encircle the extra letter
ordered means arranged, so the letters of guests are rearranged
back of picks the last letter of building

explanation.surface: Close friends are told to walk round behind the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb, pronounced intim-ATE, meaning hint.
explanation.definitionFit: To intimate is to imply or hint at something indirectly, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Learning what you're filling in?

definitions.meaning: the solver is writing these characters into the grid

explanation.surface: Is education what you're completing a form with?
explanation.definitionFit: The word means literary scholarship and also the alphabet characters a solver writes into the squares.
